articles.summary: On March 21, 2025, Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. (the “Company”) and Canaan Inc., a NASDAQ-listed publicly traded company, executed a Master Colocation Agreement (the "Agreement"). The Agreement has an initial term of three years, and the parties can extend upon mutual agreement. Under the terms of the Agreement, Mawson will provide approximately 64 MW of colocation capacity at the Company's facilities. The Agreement includes provisions for digital colocation services.
articles.title: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. Executes New Customer Agreement with Canaan Inc., Growing and Expanding Digital Colocation Business with Latest-Gen ASICs

articles.summary: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. (NASDAQ: MIGI) ("Mawson" or "the Company"), a publicly-traded technology company focused on digital infrastructure platforms for artificial intelligence (AI), high-performance computing (HPC), and digital assets markets, today announced its financial and operational results for the year ended December 31, 2024.
articles.title: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. Reports Fiscal Year 2024 Financial Results
